name: p-grill-decision-frontier
description: Design interrogation respects question dependencies and the user's stop instruction
checks: requirements.md Grill Me depth check and existing stop conditions
turns: Grill me sobre una decisión de diseño, solo en conversación: no uses herramientas ni escribas archivos. Ya confirmamos estos hechos: aplicación interna de reservas para 12 empleados, un único servidor y sin datos previos que migrar. Falta decidir si el MVP tendrá pagos. Si los incluye, después habrá que elegir proveedor y política de reembolsos; si no, esas decisiones no aplican. Empieza por las decisiones que puedo resolver ahora, con tu recomendación.
Acepto excluir pagos del MVP. Suficiente entrevista: avanza con un resumen de lo acordado y de las suposiciones restantes. No implementes ni escribas archivos.

graders.name: dependency-aware-first-round
graders.criteria: PASS only if the agent asks whether payments belong in the MVP with a recommended answer and trade-off, asks no more than five questions, and does not ask the user to select a provider or refund policy before the payment-scope prerequisite is resolved. It must not ask again for already confirmed team size, server count or existing-data facts. Mentioning downstream questions as deferred is acceptable.

graders.name: honors-stop-and-prunes-branch
graders.criteria: PASS only if the agent summarizes that payments are excluded and labels any remaining assumptions or deferrals. It does not continue interviewing, ask the now-irrelevant payment provider/refund questions, or impose an extra approval gate before giving the requested conversational summary. It does not implement.
